style_profile.name: Farinuff 2.5D Pixel Fleet
style_profile.brief: Low-poly 3D spacecraft translated into compact transparent pixel-art sprites: hard faceted planes, stepped toon shading, near-black silhouettes, and hot cyan, orange, green, or magenta emissive cores against the deep-space palette of the supplied gameplay render.
style_profile.application: Apply this visual treatment to every player, enemy, and boss sprite while preserving each existing runtime role, silhouette, proportions, generation family, frame anchor, and transparent sprite-strip layout.
must_preserve: the supplied gameplay render as a style anchor for medium, rendering, palette relationships, edge treatment, texture, and lighting only
the current player and enemy sprite identities as separate identity anchors
128x128 logical frame cells, centered 64x64 anchors, four-frame horizontal strips, and transparent backgrounds
role-readable silhouettes and the existing player, enemy, and boss family distinctions

references.description: User-approved 1280x720 gameplay render controlling the 2.5D low-poly spacecraft finish, deep-space contrast, cyan HUD-adjacent energy, violet boss materials, magenta emissive effects, crisp pixel edges, and small player read; do not copy its exact identities, layout, or object topology.
Current evolved bomber enemy silhouette and escalation reference.
